modality_control.note: The official product page states De las Tres at 15:00 and Clásico at 21:00. The official 25-Nov-2026 result mask explicitly labels 12395 De las Tres and 12396 Clásico. Do not infer 26-Nov contest ID 12398 from sequence alone; the reviewed official home page lists 12397 at 15:00 but does not list a Chispazo contest ID for 21:00.

classic_slot.caveat: The product page confirms the daily 21:00 Classic slot. The reviewed commercializer home page does not list a Chispazo contest ID for it; the separate 21:00 card is Sorteo 3093 and is not Chispazo. Contest 12398 is not confirmed by these reviewed official index/result sources.

de_las_tres_slot.note: Home page explicitly lists Chispazo contest 12397 at 15:00; the Chispazo product page maps 15:00 to De las Tres.

procedure.title: Procedimiento Sorteos Electrónicos

relevant_requirements.sphere_weighing: Every draw; one by one and in numerical order, in presence of SEGOB inspector and Lotería Nacional representatives.
relevant_requirements.weighing_strip: Signed by weighing representative, then initialled by Lotería Nacional operations representative, SEGOB inspector and Director General representative; attached to corresponding draw act.
relevant_requirements.act: Must identify place, date, event time, names, roles and signatures of commissioned Lotería Nacional officials and the SEGOB inspector, including commission order and incidents if any.
relevant_requirements.recording: Recording service covers weighing through the electronic draw; edited recording is included with the act as documentary witness.
relevant_requirements.sales_close: SICAL closed-sales summary records draw identity/date/CDC, closed state, close time and sales; printed copies are initialled by Lotería Nacional representatives and SEGOB inspector.
relevant_requirements.post_result: Post-entry SICAL summary includes winning numbers and prize/winner divisions and is reconciled with the winner-selection system.

procedure.interpretation: This is a published procedure, not evidence that any particular 26-Nov-2026 draw complied with it.

segob_role.statement: The Inspection and Surveillance area describes its responsibility to attest legality and transparency of draws carried out by institutions including Lotería Nacional.
segob_role.note: This establishes the published institutional role, not the identity or signature of the inspector assigned to a specific draw.

missing_from_this_review: original signed draw act and annexes
original recording from weighing through draw
signed participation/cancellation files and electronic signatures
independent custodian receipt and trusted timestamp/ledger anchor
